name: Content Planner Kanban
description: A handy tool to organize nodes in a Kanban. It uses the Content Moderation Workflow to display the Nodes by their workflow stati.
project_description:
Drupal Content Planner helps you to create, plan and manage content. It offers a configurable dashboards , a content calendar and a content kanban view .

 The Content Planner module is part of NodeHive, the enterprise Headless Drupal solution maintained by NETNODE AG . It's part of the SaaS offering and therefore actively maintained. The module is fully open source, ready to use and can be used outside of NodeHive.

 The only dependency is the Scheduler module .

 Use cases 
 
 You run a news/magazine site: You want to plan upcoming articles. Also you want to assign content drafts to editors and want to follow the progress of the content. 
 You run a blog: You want to plan your content schedule including your landing pages. Since you want to plan ahead, and run blog almost on "autopilot" you need to be able what's happening in the upcoming weeks. 
 Your do a new website build 
 Marketing team: You do content marketing, run campaigns and you want plan ahead
